description: Verify that DUT parses Option Overload value=2 (sname holds options) and applies Option 3 (Router) so post-BOUND UDP egress to an unrouted IP uses the gateway as L2 next-hop (RFC 2132 §9.3 + RFC 2131 §3.5/§4.1 MUST)
approach:
[Objective]
Option Overload (Option 52) lets a DHCP server stuff additional options into the BOOTP `sname` (value=2) or `file` (value=1) fields when the options blob is full. The parser must walk those secondary regions and pick up critical options — here Option 3 (Router) which selects the L3 gateway. If the parser ignores them, post-BOUND traffic to off-LAN destinations will fail.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DORA → BOUND, with OFFER carrying:
   • Option 52 (Option Overload) = 2 (sname holds options)
   • Option 3 (Router) embedded in `sname`
2. Tester → DUT: triggers DUT to send a UDP to an unrouted IP (must go via gateway).
3. DUT → wire: UDP
   • Ethernet next-hop MAC == gateway MAC (resolved via Option 3 router)   ← key check

[Pass condition]
DUT-emitted UDP uses the Option-3 router as L2 next-hop.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_no_discover / Fail_no_request — DORA missing
• Fail_no_dut_udp — DUT did not emit UDP to the unused-routed IP via the router option

verdicts.Pass: DUT applied sname-overloaded Option 3 router — normal
verdicts.Fail_no_discover: No DUT DHCPDISCOVER within the listen window
verdicts.Fail_no_dut_udp: No DUT UDP to unused-routed IP via the router option
